tools.name: handbook-introduction
tools.description: Introduction to Turbo - learn about HTML-over-the-wire approach, persistent processes, and how Turbo Drive, Frames, Streams, and Native work together to create fast web applications without heavy JavaScript frameworks

tools.name: handbook-drive
tools.description: Turbo Drive navigation guide - covers page visits, application/restoration visits, link handling, form submissions, progress indicators, caching, prefetching, and view transitions for fast page navigation

tools.name: handbook-page-refreshes
tools.description: Page refresh techniques with morphing - learn about smooth page updates using DOM morphing with idiomorph, scroll preservation, excluding sections from morphing, and broadcasting refresh streams

tools.name: handbook-frames
tools.description: Turbo Frames for page decomposition - covers independent page segments, scoped navigation, eager/lazy loading, cache benefits, targeting navigation, frame promotion to visits, and custom rendering

tools.name: handbook-streams
tools.description: Turbo Streams for live updates - learn about the 9 stream actions (append, prepend, replace, update, remove, before, after, morph, refresh), WebSocket/SSE integration, and server-side template reuse

tools.name: handbook-native
tools.description: Hotwire Native for mobile apps - overview of iOS and Android native app development using Turbo-enabled web views for hybrid applications with native navigation and web content

tools.name: handbook-building
tools.description: Building Turbo applications - covers script handling, JavaScript bundling, caching strategies, installing behavior with Stimulus, making transformations idempotent, and persisting elements across page loads

tools.name: handbook-installing
tools.description: Installing Turbo in your application - covers CDN installation, npm package setup, bundler integration, importing strategies, and Rails-specific installation with turbo-rails gem

tools.name: reference-attributes
tools.description: Complete reference for Turbo data attributes and meta tags - covers all data-turbo-* attributes for controlling Drive behavior, frame navigation, caching, and automatically added attributes like aria-busy

tools.name: reference-drive
tools.description: Turbo Drive API reference - detailed documentation of Drive methods, configuration options, and programmatic control of navigation behavior

tools.name: reference-events
tools.description: Turbo events reference - comprehensive list of all Turbo events fired during navigation, form submissions, frame updates, and stream processing for lifecycle management

tools.name: reference-frames
tools.description: Turbo Frames API reference - detailed frame element attributes, JavaScript methods, lifecycle callbacks, and programmatic frame control

tools.name: reference-streams
tools.description: Turbo Streams API reference - complete documentation of stream actions, JavaScript methods, custom action creation, and programmatic stream handling
